data.name: Realms Of Wands
data.detailed_description:
The kingdom has fallen. Magic is fading. Darkness is rising.

Step into the world of Realms of Wands, a dark fantasy action RPG where ancient kingdoms lie in ruins, powerful relics have been scattered across the land, and monstrous creatures roam forgotten realms. Every journey leads deeper into a world filled with danger, mystery, and legendary rewards.

Battle your way through cursed forests, abandoned castles, haunted crypts, frozen wastelands, volcanic caverns, and forgotten temples as you uncover the truth behind the collapse of the realm.

Master powerful weapons, unlock devastating spells, collect rare equipment, and create unique character builds to survive increasingly difficult enemies and colossal boss encounters.

Whether you're hunting for legendary loot, completing quests, or perfecting your build, every adventure offers new challenges and discoveries.

Features

  • Explore a handcrafted dark fantasy world filled with secrets.

  • Fast-paced real-time combat against monsters, undead, demons, and powerful bosses.

  • Discover and equip unique weapons, armour, relics, and magical artifacts.

  • Learn powerful spells and combine abilities to create your own combat style.

  • Complete quests and uncover the history of the fallen kingdoms.

  • Earn experience, level up, and unlock permanent character upgrades.

  • Craft stronger equipment and improve your arsenal.

  • Face epic boss battles that test your skill and strategy.

  • Discover hidden areas, rare treasures, and legendary loot.

  • Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud support.

  • Designed for keyboard and mouse, with future controller support planned.

Will You Restore the Realm?

The darkness continues to spread across the land, and only those brave enough to face impossible odds can stand against it.

Gather your weapons.

Master the arcane.

Challenge ancient evils.

Forge your legend.

The fate of the realm now rests in your hands.

data.short_description: Explore a dark fantasy world in Realms of Wands, an action RPG filled with epic boss battles, powerful magic, legendary loot, and dangerous dungeons. Level up, forge your destiny, and uncover the secrets of a fallen kingdom

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (2 GB) or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. Gamepad support coming in a future update
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (6th Generation)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Integrated Graphics or Intel Iris Plus Graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Core Audio compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. Compatible with Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7 (8th Generation or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X or better
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Core Audio compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for the best loading times. Native Apple Silicon support recommended.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (2 GB), AMD Radeon R7 260X, or Intel UHD Graphics 620
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL or PulseAudio compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit operating system required. Keyboard and mouse required. And Gampepads are supported
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.5+
  • Processor: ntel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB), AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB), or Intel Arc A380
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL or PulseAudio compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for the best loading performance. Fully compatible with Steam Deck and modern Linux distributions.
